conclusions: All fifteen live Super calls delivered complete JSON with known logical and physical usage. No provider failure, retry, truncation, JSON syntax rejection or local delivery block was observed.

Direct reasoning attempted all four cases and accepted one first proposal. Six other direct proposals failed unchanged exact certificate acceptance; no direct repair succeeded. The native-available arm attempted all four cases and accepted none.

The native arm made three actual tool requests: two constructed incorrect native proposals reached independent acceptance, and one execution was insufficient. Five proposals failed source-reference admission. The two interpolation stages never reached mathematical grading; no authority refusal occurred.

Six distinct arm/task stages reached exact mathematical/certificate grading, two remained ungraded, and none were unexecuted. Eight proposals were rejected by exact acceptance and one was accepted. First attempts comprised one acceptance, five exact rejections and two native-IR rejections; second attempts comprised three exact rejections, three native-IR rejections and one insufficient native derivation.

All fifteen output sets were complete; certificate-schema and objective-output rejections were zero. Direct exact-string mismatches were not separately assessed for mathematically equivalent noncanonical representations. Frozen BOTH_REJECTED_MATHEMATICS labels denote exact acceptance rejection, not a recovered proof that every direct number was mathematically false.

Direct used seven logical/physical calls and 19231 reported tokens; native used eight and 36243. Every pair used no more direct calls, HTTP attempts and tokens, while zero pairs met the five-percent realized matching tolerance. Tool availability and representation deliberately differed. The single direct-only success is a scoped diagnostic signal, not broad cognitive improvement or causal attribution.

All seven direct submissions reported confidence 1; six failed exact acceptance. This is an observed small-sample overconfidence warning, not a calibrated task-population estimate. Native compound-certificate confidence is tool-generated and is not a comparable model-confidence measure.

Independent first proposals, one four-case epoch and two already-known formal families limit generalization. The default, authority, cognition, official benchmark score, tool invention, procedure transfer and recursion remain unpromoted.

Reproduce its applicability to exact-certificate generation separately; freeze fresh values and shared-first control/treatment repairs with unchanged acceptance, finite equal caps and full actual-compute accounting. Track native source-reference failures independently. This recommendation is not a launched campaign or a claim of successful correction.
